coincurve_preflight.batch_api_evidence: Coincurve/PublicKeyXOnly exposes only individual verify; no native batch API was found.

environment.security_note: Timing is environment-dependent and is not constant-time or side-channel evidence.
environment.speedup_definition: baseline median ns / comparison median ns
environment.timing: perf_counter_ns; each row reports median, mean, sample standard deviation, minimum and maximum per operation. Fixture setup and preflight are excluded.

method_notes.batch-csprng: Production batch API; coefficients generated from secrets for every invocation.
method_notes.batch-fixed-coefficients: Deterministic coefficient mode for repeatability only; it is not production verification.
method_notes.individual: Checks every member separately without short-circuiting invalid batches.
method_notes.naive-python-glv: Sum of per-term python-glv scalar multiplications and affine additions.
method_notes.native-batch: Unavailable: Coincurve 19.0.1 exposes no native batch Schnorr API.
method_notes.native-individual-libsecp256k1: Coincurve/PublicKeyXOnly individual verification; native public-key objects are preconstructed outside timed operations.
method_notes.straus-glv-wnaf: Existing Straus MSM; internally uses GLV decomposition and interleaved wNAF.

native_backend_capabilities.evidence: Coincurve/PublicKeyXOnly exposes only individual verify; no native batch API was found.

performance_analysis.speedup_definition: baseline median ns / comparison median ns
